title: Planificar y reponer frontier útil
mission: Act as GUIDE_PLANNER. If the high-value claimable frontier is thin relative to worker launch pressure, synthesize current project goals plus recent returns and materialize a small set of bounded non-duplicate jobs. Include execution/verification/integration lanes as evidence requires. Do not produce filler or prose-only plans.
definition_of_done: Current claimable frontier and recent returns are reloaded before planning.
The dominant bottleneck and at least one alternative route are considered.
Between 1 and 7 safe useful jobs are materialized when supported by evidence; no filler is created to hit a quota.
Each created job has a stable dedupe key, bounded mission and explicit acceptance criteria.
At least one job is execution/integration/verification when software-solvable work exists; the output is not all analysis.
A guide receipt records the trigger, created jobs and any real human-decision boundary.
